The gate's first screen: the product hero, Sign in, Use a license key, and the extras the product supports, such as a trial, restoring a purchase or activating offline. It offers only the paths the build supports, so a key-only product never shows a sign-in button. The title names the product; a product with no name reads "Welcome".

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="SwiftUI">
    <KitStatus kit="swiftui" />

    **Drop-in.** The gate's first screen inside `.polarisKeyGate`: the 120 pt hero icon, `Welcome to <Product>`, `by <Developer>`, Sign in (Liquid Glass primary) and Use a license key (glass secondary); a one-path product says so in the lede and shows that path inline.

    **Styled part.** `WelcomeView(screen:onSignIn:onUseKey:onExtra:inline:)` and `.welcomeStyle(_:)`.

    **Headless.** `KitStates.welcome(_:)`; `PolarisKeyGateModel.welcome`.

    [SwiftUI](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/swiftui/) has the theme, the restyle hooks and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Electron">
    <KitStatus kit="electron" />

    **Drop-in.** Drawn by `<PolarisKeyGate>` when the license state calls for it, in the chrome of the OS.

    **Styled part.** The React kit's `<Welcome />`, drawn in the macOS, Windows or GNOME chrome with `theme.platform: "auto"`; restyle through `data-part` and the `--pk-*` hooks.

    **Headless.** `viewOf("Welcome", input)`.

    [Electron](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/electron/) has the bridge, the menu and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Compose">
    <KitStatus kit="compose" />

    **Drop-in.** The gate's first screen; nothing to place.

    **Styled part.** `PolarisKitScreen(screen, onAction)` draws the hero, Sign in and Use a license key; restyle through `PolarisTheme`.

    **Headless.** `KitStates.resolve(KitComponent.welcome, inputs)`.

    ```kotlin android
    import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
    import im.plrs.key.ui.KitAction
    import im.plrs.key.ui.KitComponent
    import im.plrs.key.ui.KitInputs
    import im.plrs.key.ui.KitStates
    import im.plrs.key.ui.PolarisKitScreen

    @Composable
    fun MyWelcome(inputs: KitInputs, onAction: (KitAction?) -> Unit) {
        PolarisKitScreen(KitStates.resolve(KitComponent.welcome, inputs), onAction = onAction)
    }
    ```

    [Compose](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/compose/) has the one-liner, the sample and the routes; Compose Desktop opens the same screens in OS windows.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Godot">
    <KitStatus kit="godot" />

    <GodotKitTab component="Welcome" />

  </TabItem>
</Tabs>
